# Scrapbook asset sources

Wonnie now uses a separate photo-referenced illustration in `cutouts/wonnie.webp`: a slender grey-brown tabby with dark stripes, a white chest and white paws, based on the owner's supplied26 October2026 photograph. The other four cats keep their original illustration windows. The same complete Wonnie source is used on the page and in both cat readers. This is generated paper artwork, not the original photograph; generation, alpha and delivery details are in [cutouts/PROVENANCE.md](cutouts/PROVENANCE.md).

The live Trier–Luxembourg map now shows the owner's RE11 outward train and L31 bus return as a geographically anchored schematic. Verified railway-location facts come from CFL/ACF and OpenStreetMap; the simplified bus connection does not claim an exact road trace or terminal. Credits appear inside the map, with detailed sources, rights, projection and limitations in [illustrations/trier-luxembourg-route.md](illustrations/trier-luxembourg-route.md). The old below-map technical caption is removed.

V43 groups the existing photographs into small collages and adds a restrained warm display grade plus paper/cover detail. Original source files are unchanged; on-screen color/framing changes are documented in [FANDOM-PHOTOS.md](FANDOM-PHOTOS.md). The actual club crest keeps its original colors. This finishing adds no personal content, generated likeness or endorsement claim.

Taylor Swift, Olivia Rodrigo, Olivia Dean and Sienna Spiro now use real portrait photographs, replacing the four symbolic music-prop stickers. Lionel Messi, Lamine Yamal and the actual FC Barcelona crest join the collection. Full credits, source links, license distinctions, exact byte hashes and presentation frames are in [FANDOM-PHOTOS.md](FANDOM-PHOTOS.md). Taylor and Olivia Rodrigo are credited to iHeartRadioCA under CC BY 3.0; the other new media remains credited third-party copyright. No endorsement or personal-photo claim is made.

The Alex Albon, Lewis Hamilton, George Russell, Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri face stickers use actual 2026 official Formula 1 driver portraits, downloaded on 25 October 2026 from their driver pages. Copyright Formula One World Championship Limited and the respective rights holders; these photographs are not Creative Commons images or original generated art. The original WebP files are retained unchanged, with individually measured head-and-neck presentation windows. They are personal fan decorations and imply no endorsement. Sources, exact media URLs, byte hashes and crop measurements are in [cutouts/PROVENANCE.md](cutouts/PROVENANCE.md).

Sixteen original paper ornaments were generated for this scrapbook and placed as 36 decorative keepsakes: bows, pressed flowers and leaves, cherries, souvenir stamps, a blank rail ticket, washi tape, a wax seal, key, moon-and-stars cutout, racing flag, butterfly, record and hearts. They use the existing pink/sage palette. The Luxembourg bridge and Trier Porta Nigra stamps are illustrative souvenirs, not personal photographs or claims that these landmarks were visited. No decorative ticket contains invented travel details. The transparent source atlas is retained without repainting; measured individual frames preserve each whole motif. See [cutouts/PROVENANCE.md](cutouts/PROVENANCE.md).

Seven illustrated fan stickers represent the recipient's supplied favorites: Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, George Russell, Taylor Swift, Olivia Rodrigo, Olivia Dean and Sienna Spiro. Original artwork was generated for this scrapbook and uses racing/music keepsake motifs with accessible names and no visible captions. The original RGBA sheet and its per-sticker frames retain complete silhouettes. Generation and file provenance: [cutouts/PROVENANCE.md](cutouts/PROVENANCE.md).

The historical central-Trier map uses actual OpenStreetMap river-bank, street and landmark geometry downloaded through the Overpass API on 17 October 2026. It is retained as a source asset rather than the live map. Its1000x650 WebP and editable SVG are included; no route or claim of places visited was added to that earlier asset.

Map data copyright OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License. Attribution and license: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright

Primary landmark and water geometry:

- Mosel river-bank relation: https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/4237348
- Porta Nigra: https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/10106558273
- Hauptmarkt: https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/5761430684

The map contains its attribution and Source Sans3 labels. A linked attribution is also available in the map dialog.

Fraunces is by Phaedra Charles and Flavia Zimbardi, Undercase Type. Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/fraunces

Source Sans3 is by Paul D. Hunt, Adobe. Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/sourcesans3

Both fonts use the SIL Open Font License. Their license files are included in assets/fonts. The Fraunces print subset fixes optical size36, softness35 and wonk0; weight remains variable400-600. Source Sans3 print subsets retain weights400-600. Latin and Latin-ext are served separately.

The existing five-cat artwork illustrates the supplied descriptions. Minnie is based on the supplied reference photograph. It does not represent real trip photography. The same source image is displayed through five individual cropped sticker mounts; no coat descriptions have been changed.
